title: Export
pdfNote: A print window opens. Choose Save as PDF to save it as a file.
archiveNote: A lossless copy of this page and its subpages, files included, that Leafen can import again.
failed: Couldn’t export this page. Try again.
linkOutside: A linked database or relation on this page points to a database outside it, so this page can’t be exported as a Leafen archive on its own. Use Export workspace archive to take it with its source.
turnedOff: Exports are turned off by your organization or this page’s teamspace. Ask a workspace admin if you need one.
